cashflow: Money in and out by month, in dollars. Transfers between the household's own accounts are excluded. Spending shows as positive numbers.
budget: Only explicitly configured budgets are shown. Monthly actuals need a closed period; year-to-date comparisons need history from 1 July. A zero budget is an explicit zero limit.
savings: Unavailable in the basic household profile. No figures have been inferred; this domain needs a separately reviewed configuration.
mortgage: Unavailable in the basic household profile. No figures have been inferred; this domain needs a separately reviewed configuration.

Only actual salary deposits and payslips require matching evidence. A household without income does not need a fictional payslip.
Accounts with no activity in the latest month
No activity can be legitimate. The authoritative close requires a reviewed statement for every account, including inactive months.
Subscriptions charged but not on the list
A new subscription, often a free trial that rolled into a paid plan, is invisible to the usage and price checks until it is on the list.

networth: Cash begins at the opening anchor. Whole-household net worth and asset classes are unavailable until their domains are configured.
